text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Tuesday: NEUE ZUERCHER ZEITUNG

- Swiss Minister Flavio Cotti confirmed that Carlo Jagmetti, Swiss Ambassador to the United States, resigned on Monday following remarks he made in which he called dealing with Holocaust money crisis "waging a war". - The Swiss Federal Department of Health said a total of 5,535 AIDS cases were registered at the end of 1996, amounting to an average of 7.8 people out of 100,000, down from a rate of 10.7 per 100,000 in 1995. - Law firms in the U.S. and Canada are looking for people via the Internet who believe they have a right to funds belonging to Holocaust victims and want to file suit against Swiss banks. - The number of management-buyouts in Switzerland totalled to 48 in 1996. - Electro-engineering group ABB is taking a 60 percent stake in PBE, Poland's Energy Construction Enterprpise. TAGES ANZEIGER - Swiss President Arnold Koller asked the president of the Maledives to pardon a Swiss man sentenced to life in prison there in April for possession of hemp seeds. - Switzerland's Maag AG sold Maag Pump Systems AG and Maag Italia S.p.A. to U.S. firm Textron for an undisclosed price. - Swiss Bank Corp's subsidiary Banca della Svizzera Italiana posted a gross profit increase of 22.4 percent to 129.6 million Swiss francs for 1996. - Switzerland's Department for Social Insurance is cutting prices of certain medication by 50 percent. - Kraftwerke Mauvoisin AG posted a 50.5 million Swiss franc profit for the 1995/96 fiscal year ending September 30, a decrease of 5.4 percent. - Three Swiss firms are among the top 10 in Europe, according to a ranking by the Financial Times, which found new pharmaceuticals giant Novartis to be number two, Roche in third place, and Nestle in ninth. JOURNAL DE GENEVE - The Socialist Party's demand for Jean-Pascal Delamuraz to resign has caused some hefty criticism in western Switzerland where Waadtland Social Democrats have distanced themselves from the Swiss Socialist Party. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
